```{r}
# Section 2
# Set up Python and IBM CPLEX
python_bin <- Sys.which(
  "python3"
)
if (python_bin == "") {
  stop(
    "python3 was not found. Install Python 3 before continuing."
  )
}
cat(
  "Using Python:",
  python_bin,
  "\n"
)
run_python_command <- function(args) {
  out <- system2(
    python_bin,
    args = args,
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE
  )
  status <- attr(
    out,
    "status"
  )
  if (is.null(status)) {
    status <- 0L
  }
  list(
    output = out,
    status = status
  )
}
check_cplex <- run_python_command(
  c(
    "-c",
    shQuote(
      "import cplex; print(cplex.__version__)"
    )
  )
)
if (check_cplex$status != 0) {
  cat(
    "Python CPLEX package not found. Attempting installation...\n"
  )
  system2(
    python_bin,
    args = c(
      "-m",
      "pip",
      "install",
      "cplex",
      "docplex"
    )
  )
  check_cplex <- run_python_command(
    c(
      "-c",
      shQuote(
        "import cplex; print(cplex.__version__)"
      )
    )
  )
}
if (check_cplex$status != 0) {
  stop(
    "CPLEX could not be imported into Python."
  )
}
cat(
  "CPLEX version:",
  paste(
    check_cplex$output,
    collapse = " "
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 3
# Create Python CPLEX solver
CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT <- file.path(
  tempdir(),
  "solve_cplex.py"
)
python_solver <- c(
  "import sys",
  "import cplex",
  "",
  "lpfile = sys.argv[1]",
  "solfile = sys.argv[2]",
  "",
  "problem = cplex.Cplex(lpfile)",
  "",
  "problem.set_log_stream(None)",
  "problem.set_warning_stream(None)",
  "problem.set_results_stream(None)",
  "",
  "problem.parameters.threads.set(1)",
  "",
  "problem.parameters.mip.tolerances.mipgap.set(1e-6)",
  "",
  "problem.solve()",
  "",
  "status = problem.solution.get_status_string()",
  "print('CPLEX status:', status)",
  "",
  "if not problem.solution.is_primal_feasible():",
  "    print('No primal feasible solution found.')",
  "    sys.exit(2)",
  "",
  "objective = problem.solution.get_objective_value()",
  "print('Objective:', objective)",
  "",
  "try:",
  "    gap = problem.solution.MIP.get_mip_relative_gap()",
  "    print('MIP gap:', gap)",
  "except:",
  "    pass",
  "",
  "problem.solution.write(solfile)"
)
writeLines(
  python_solver,
  CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT
)
cat(
  "Created CPLEX solver at:\n",
  CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT,
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 4
# Exact fixed-size best subset selection using CPLEX
best_subset_cplex <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s,
    M = 20
) {
  n <- nrow(X)
  p <- ncol(X)
  work <- tempfile(
    "cplex_"
  )
  dir.create(
    work
  )
  on.exit(
    unlink(
      work,
      recursive = TRUE
    ),
    add = TRUE
  )
  lpfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "model.lp"
  )
  solfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "solution.sol"
  )
  con <- file(
    lpfile,
    "wt"
  )
  # Objective
  writeLines(
    "Minimize",
    con
  )
  writeLines(
    " obj: [",
    con
  )
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " + 2 r_%d ^ 2",
        i
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(
    " ] / 2",
    con
  )
  # Residual constraints
  writeLines(
    "Subject To",
    con
  )
  chunk <- 10
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    starts <- seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = chunk
    )
    for (cc in seq_along(starts)) {
      start <- starts[cc]
      finish <- min(
        start + chunk - 1,
        p
      )
      txt <- ""
      if (cc == 1) {
        txt <- sprintf(
          " resid_%d:",
          i
        )
      }
      for (j in start:finish) {
        a <- X[
          i,
          j
        ]
        if (abs(a) < 1e-14) {
          next
        }
        if (a >= 0) {
          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(
              " + %.12g beta_%d",
              a,
              j
            )
          )
        } else {
          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(
              " - %.12g beta_%d",
              -a,
              j
            )
          )
        }
      }
      if (finish == p) {
        txt <- paste0(
          txt,
          sprintf(
            " + r_%d = %.12g",
            i,
            y[i]
          )
        )
      }
      writeLines(
        txt,
        con
      )
    }
  }
  # Big-M constraints
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " U%d: beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),
      con
    )
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " L%d: - beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  # Exactly s predictors
  writeLines(
    " card:",
    con
  )
  chunk_z <- 25
  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = chunk_z
    )
  ) {
    finish <- min(
      start + chunk_z - 1,
      p
    )
    txt <- ""
    for (j in start:finish) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " + z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }
    if (finish == p) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " = %d",
          s
        )
      )
    }
    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }
  # Bounds
  writeLines(
    "Bounds",
    con
  )
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " -%.12g <= beta_%d <= %.12g",
        M,
        j,
        M
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " r_%d free",
        i
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  # Binary variables
  writeLines(
    "Binary",
    con
  )
  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = 25
    )
  ) {
    finish <- min(
      start + 24,
      p
    )
    txt <- ""
    for (j in start:finish) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }
    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(
    "End",
    con
  )
  close(
    con
  )
  # Solve
  solve_start <- proc.time()[3]
  out <- system2(
    python_bin,
    args = c(
      shQuote(
        CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT
      ),
      shQuote(
        lpfile
      ),
      shQuote(
        solfile
      )
    ),
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE
  )
  solve_seconds <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    solve_start
  if (!file.exists(
    solfile
  )) {
    cat(
      paste(
        out,
        collapse = "\n"
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    stop(
      "CPLEX did not produce a solution."
    )
  }
  status_line <- grep(
    "^CPLEX status:",
    out,
    value = TRUE
  )
  cplex_status <-
    if (length(status_line) > 0) {
      sub(
        "^CPLEX status:[[:space:]]*",
        "",
        status_line[1]
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  gap_line <- grep(
    "^MIP gap:",
    out,
    value = TRUE
  )
  mip_gap <-
    if (length(gap_line) > 0) {
      as.numeric(
        sub(
          "^MIP gap:[[:space:]]*",
          "",
          gap_line[1]
        )
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  sol <- readLines(
    solfile,
    warn = FALSE
  )
  beta <- numeric(p)
  z <- numeric(p)
  for (line in sol) {
    if (!grepl(
      "<variable",
      line,
      fixed = TRUE
    )) {
      next
    }
    name_match <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'name="([^"]+)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]
    if (length(name_match) != 2) {
      next
    }
    name <- name_match[2]
    value_match <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'value="([-+]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]*)?|\\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]
    if (length(value_match) != 2) {
      next
    }
    value <- as.numeric(
      value_match[2]
    )
    if (grepl(
      "^beta_[0-9]+$",
      name
    )) {
      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^beta_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )
      if (!is.na(j) && j <= p) {
        beta[j] <- value
      }
    }
    if (grepl(
      "^z_[0-9]+$",
      name
    )) {
      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^z_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )
      if (!is.na(j) && j <= p) {
        z[j] <- value
      }
    }
  }
  rss <- sum(
    (
      y -
        X %*% beta
    )^2
  )
  max_abs_beta <- max(
    abs(beta)
  )
  if (
    max_abs_beta >
      0.95 * M
  ) {
    warning(
      "A CPLEX coefficient is close to Big-M."
    )
  }
  list(
    selected =
      which(
        z > 0.5
      ),
    beta =
      beta,
    z =
      z,
    rss =
      rss,
    status =
      cplex_status,
    mip_gap =
      mip_gap,
    solve_seconds =
      solve_seconds,
    max_abs_beta =
      max_abs_beta,
    cplex_output =
      out
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 5
# Experiment 2 settings - Effect of SNR
# Baseline dimensions
n <- 200
p <- 50
# Fixed true model size
s_true <- 4
# Fixed predictor correlation
rho <- 0.20
# Signal-to-noise ratios
snr_values <- c(
  0.1,
  0.25,
  0.5,
  0.75,
  1,
  2,
  5
)
# Monte Carlo replications
n_rep <- 100
# For testing:
# n_rep <- 5
# True coefficient magnitudes
beta_min <- 1
beta_max <- 2
# CPLEX
big_M <- 20
# L0Learn
#
# Continue well beyond the true size so that the regularisation
# path can contain as many different cardinalities as possible.
l0_max_support <- 20
# Main dense lambda grid
l0_grid_points <- 1200
# Extend both ends of pilot lambda range
l0_upper_multiplier <- 2
l0_lower_multiplier <- 0.02
# L0Learn adaptive refinement
#
# Every interval in which the support size jumps by more than
# one is refined. This is intended to recover narrow lambda
# intervals associated with otherwise skipped model sizes.
l0_refine_points_per_gap <- 100
l0_refine_rounds <- 2
# Reproducibility
master_seed <- 12345
cat(
  "Experiment 2 - Effect of SNR\n\n"
)
cat(
  "n =",
  n,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "p =",
  p,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "True model size =",
  s_true,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "rho =",
  rho,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "SNR values =",
  paste(
    snr_values,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Replications =",
  n_rep,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "L0Learn initial lambda grid =",
  l0_grid_points,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "L0Learn refinement rounds =",
  l0_refine_rounds,
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 6
# Generate one Monte Carlo replication
#
# Population-SNR version
generate_replication_base <- function(
    rep_id,
    n,
    p,
    rho,
    s_true,
    beta_min,
    beta_max,
    master_seed
) {
  set.seed(
    master_seed +
      rep_id
  )
  # Equicorrelated Gaussian predictors
  #
  # X_j = sqrt(rho) Z_0 + sqrt(1-rho) Z_j
  #
  # Population covariance:
  #
  # Sigma_rho = (1-rho) I_p + rho 11'
  common_factor <- rnorm(
    n
  )
  Z <- matrix(
    rnorm(
      n * p
    ),
    nrow = n,
    ncol = p
  )
  X_raw <- sqrt(
    rho
  ) *
    matrix(
      common_factor,
      nrow = n,
      ncol = p
    ) +
    sqrt(
      1 - rho
    ) *
    Z
  # Population covariance matrix
  Sigma_rho <-
    (
      1 -
        rho
    ) *
    diag(
      p
    ) +
    rho *
    matrix(
      1,
      nrow = p,
      ncol = p
    )
  # True support
  #
  # Held fixed across all SNR values within this replication.
  true_support <- sort(
    sample(
      seq_len(
        p
      ),
      size = s_true,
      replace = FALSE
    )
  )
  # True coefficients
  #
  # Also held fixed across all SNR values.
  magnitudes <- runif(
    s_true,
    min = beta_min,
    max = beta_max
  )
  signs <- sample(
    c(
      -1,
      1
    ),
    size = s_true,
    replace = TRUE
  )
  beta_true <- numeric(
    p
  )
  beta_true[
    true_support
  ] <-
    signs *
    magnitudes
  # Population signal variance
  #
  # Var(x' beta*) = beta*' Sigma_rho beta*
  population_signal_variance <- as.numeric(
    t(
      beta_true
    ) %*%
      Sigma_rho %*%
      beta_true
  )
  # Common raw standard-normal noise direction
  #
  # IMPORTANT:
  # Do NOT centre or standardise this vector.
  #
  # The same noise direction is used across all SNR values
  # within a replication. Only its scale changes.
  epsilon_base <- rnorm(
    n
  )
  list(
    X_raw =
      X_raw,
    Sigma_rho =
      Sigma_rho,
    true_support =
      true_support,
    beta_true =
      beta_true,
    population_signal_variance =
      population_signal_variance,
    epsilon_base =
      epsilon_base
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 7
# Construct dataset at a particular SNR
#
# Population-SNR version
make_dataset_snr <- function(
    base,
    target_snr
) {
  X_raw <- base$X_raw
  p <- ncol(
    X_raw
  )
  # Population noise variance
  #
  # target_snr =
  #
  # beta*' Sigma_rho beta* / sigma^2
  #
  # therefore
  #
  # sigma^2 =
  #
  # beta*' Sigma_rho beta* / target_snr
  sigma_sq <-
    base$population_signal_variance /
    target_snr
  sigma <- sqrt(
    sigma_sq
  )
  # Signal generated from the raw population design
  signal_raw <- as.vector(
    X_raw %*%
      base$beta_true
  )
  # Noise
  #
  # epsilon_base is identical across the SNR values.
  # Only sigma changes.
  epsilon <-
    sigma *
    base$epsilon_base
  # Response on original scale
  y_raw <-
    signal_raw +
    epsilon
  # Standardise predictors for fitting
  #
  # This occurs AFTER the response has been generated.
  X <- as.matrix(
    scale(
      X_raw,
      center = TRUE,
      scale = TRUE
    )
  )
  colnames(
    X
  ) <- paste0(
    "X",
    seq_len(
      p
    )
  )
  # Centre response
  #
  # All methods are fitted without an intercept.
  y <- as.numeric(
    y_raw -
      mean(
        y_raw
      )
  )
  # Realised sample SNR
  #
  # This is a diagnostic only.
  #
  # It should fluctuate naturally around target_snr rather
  # than being forced to equal it exactly.
  realised_snr <-
    var(
      signal_raw
    ) /
    var(
      epsilon
    )
  list(
    X =
      X,
    y =
      y,
    beta_true =
      base$beta_true,
    true_support =
      base$true_support,
    sigma =
      sigma,
    sigma_sq =
      sigma_sq,
    population_signal_variance =
      base$population_signal_variance,
    target_snr =
      target_snr,
    realised_snr =
      realised_snr
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 8
# Common helper functions
ols_refit <- function(
    X,
    y,
    support
) {
  support <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(
        support
      )
    )
  )
  p <- ncol(
    X
  )
  if (length(support) == 0) {
    return(
      list(
        beta =
          numeric(p),
        fitted =
          rep(
            0,
            length(y)
          ),
        rss =
          sum(
            y^2
          )
      )
    )
  }
  Xs <- X[
    ,
    support,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  fit <- lm.fit(
    x = Xs,
    y = y
  )
  beta <- numeric(
    p
  )
  beta[
    support
  ] <- fit$coefficients
  list(
    beta =
      beta,
    fitted =
      as.vector(
        fit$fitted.values
      ),
    rss =
      sum(
        fit$residuals^2
      )
  )
}
support_metrics <- function(
    selected,
    truth
) {
  selected <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(selected)
    )
  )
  truth <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(truth)
    )
  )
  TP <- length(
    intersect(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )
  FP <- length(
    setdiff(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )
  FN <- length(
    setdiff(
      truth,
      selected
    )
  )
  precision <-
    if (length(selected) > 0) {
      TP /
        length(selected)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  recall <-
    TP /
    length(truth)
  union_size <- length(
    union(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )
  jaccard <-
    if (union_size > 0) {
      TP /
        union_size
    } else {
      1
    }
  exact <- setequal(
    selected,
    truth
  )
  list(
    exact =
      exact,
    TP =
      TP,
    FP =
      FP,
    FN =
      FN,
    precision =
      precision,
    recall =
      recall,
    jaccard =
      jaccard
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 9
# CPLEX wrapper
fit_cplex_method <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s,
    M
) {
  start_time <- proc.time()[3]
  fit <- best_subset_cplex(
    X = X,
    y = y,
    s = s,
    M = M
  )
  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    start_time
  support <- sort(
    as.integer(
      fit$selected
    )
  )
  list(
    support =
      support,
    runtime =
      runtime,
    exact_size_available =
      length(support) ==
      s,
    status =
      fit$status,
    mip_gap =
      fit$mip_gap,
    max_abs_beta =
      fit$max_abs_beta
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 10
# COMBSS wrapper
fit_combss_method <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s
) {
  start_time <- proc.time()[3]
  fit <- combss::combss(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    family = "gaussian",
    q = s,
    lam_ridge = 0,
    Niter = 100,
    alpha = 0.1,
    scale = FALSE,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    start_time
  if (
    length(
      fit$subset_list
    ) < s
  ) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "COMBSS did not return model size",
        s
      )
    )
  }
  support <- sort(
    as.integer(
      fit$subset_list[[
        s
      ]]
    )
  )
  list(
    support =
      support,
    runtime =
      runtime,
    exact_size_available =
      length(
        support
      ) ==
      s
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 11
# ABESS wrapper
fit_abess_method <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s
) {
  start_time <- proc.time()[3]
  fit <- abess::abess(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    family = "gaussian",
    tune.path = "sequence",
    support.size = s,
    tune.type = "gic",
    lambda = 0,
    normalize = 0,
    fit.intercept = FALSE,
    early.stop = FALSE,
    warm.start = TRUE,
    num.threads = 1
  )
  model <- abess::extract(
    fit,
    support.size = s
  )
  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    start_time
  beta_hat <- as.numeric(
    model$beta
  )
  support <- sort(
    which(
      abs(
        beta_hat
      ) >
        1e-10
    )
  )
  list(
    support =
      support,
    runtime =
      runtime,
    exact_size_available =
      length(support) ==
      s
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 12
# Dense and adaptively refined L0Learn path
fit_l0learn_dense <- function(
    X,
    y,
    target_s,
    max_support,
    grid_points = 1200,
    upper_multiplier = 2,
    lower_multiplier = 0.02,
    refine_points_per_gap = 100,
    refine_rounds = 2
) {
  total_start <- proc.time()[3]
  # STEP 1
  # Pilot path
  pilot_fit <- L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    loss = "SquaredError",
    penalty = "L0",
    algorithm = "CD",
    maxSuppSize =
      max_support,
    nLambda = 100,
    scaleDownFactor = 0.80,
    intercept = FALSE
  )
  pilot_lambda <- as.numeric(
    pilot_fit$lambda[[1]]
  )
  pilot_lambda <- pilot_lambda[
    is.finite(
      pilot_lambda
    ) &
      pilot_lambda >
      0
  ]
  if (length(pilot_lambda) < 2) {
    stop(
      "L0Learn pilot path did not produce a usable lambda range."
    )
  }
  lambda_upper <-
    max(
      pilot_lambda
    ) *
    upper_multiplier
  lambda_lower <-
    min(
      pilot_lambda
    ) *
    lower_multiplier
  # STEP 2
  # Initial dense grid
  lambda_grid <- exp(
    seq(
      from =
        log(
          lambda_upper
        ),
      to =
        log(
          lambda_lower
        ),
      length.out =
        grid_points
    )
  )
  # Function for fitting one explicit lambda grid
  run_cdpsi <- function(
      lambda_values
  ) {
    L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
      x = X,
      y = y,
      loss = "SquaredError",
      penalty = "L0",
      algorithm = "CDPSI",
      maxSuppSize =
        max_support,
      lambdaGrid =
        list(
          lambda_values
        ),
      partialSort = TRUE,
      maxIters = 200,
      rtol = 1e-6,
      atol = 1e-9,
      activeSet = TRUE,
      activeSetNum = 3,
      maxSwaps = 100,
      screenSize = ncol(X),
      intercept = FALSE
    )
  }
  # STEP 3
  # Initial CDPSI path
  fit <- run_cdpsi(
    lambda_grid
  )
  refinement_rounds_used <- 0
  # STEP 4
  # Refine every lambda interval where cardinality jumps
  if (refine_rounds > 0) {
    for (
      rr in seq_len(
        refine_rounds
      )
    ) {
      fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
        fit$lambda[[1]]
      )
      support_sizes <- as.integer(
        fit$suppSize[[1]]
      )
      # Sort explicitly by decreasing lambda
      ord <- order(
        fitted_lambda,
        decreasing = TRUE
      )
      lambda_ordered <-
        fitted_lambda[
          ord
        ]
      size_ordered <-
        support_sizes[
          ord
        ]
      # Find jumps of more than one model size
      gap_indices <- which(
        abs(
          diff(
            size_ordered
          )
        ) >
          1
      )
      if (
        length(
          gap_indices
        ) == 0
      ) {
        break
      }
      extra_lambda <- numeric(
        0
      )
      for (
        i in gap_indices
      ) {
        lambda_a <-
          lambda_ordered[
            i
          ]
        lambda_b <-
          lambda_ordered[
            i + 1
          ]
        upper <- max(
          lambda_a,
          lambda_b
        )
        lower <- min(
          lambda_a,
          lambda_b
        )
        if (
          is.finite(
            upper
          ) &&
            is.finite(
              lower
            ) &&
            lower > 0 &&
            upper > lower
        ) {
          local_grid <- exp(
            seq(
              from =
                log(
                  upper
                ),
              to =
                log(
                  lower
                ),
              length.out =
                refine_points_per_gap +
                2
            )
          )
          # Remove existing endpoints
          local_grid <- local_grid[
            -c(
              1,
              length(
                local_grid
              )
            )
          ]
          extra_lambda <- c(
            extra_lambda,
            local_grid
          )
        }
      }
      if (
        length(
          extra_lambda
        ) == 0
      ) {
        break
      }
      new_lambda_grid <- sort(
        unique(
          c(
            lambda_grid,
            extra_lambda
          )
        ),
        decreasing = TRUE
      )
      if (
        length(
          new_lambda_grid
        ) ==
          length(
            lambda_grid
          )
      ) {
        break
      }
      lambda_grid <-
        new_lambda_grid
      refinement_rounds_used <-
        rr
      # Refit over refined grid
      fit <- run_cdpsi(
        lambda_grid
      )
    }
  }
  # STEP 5
  # Final path
  support_sizes <- as.integer(
    fit$suppSize[[1]]
  )
  fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
    fit$lambda[[1]]
  )
  beta_path <- as.matrix(
    fit$beta[[1]]
  )
  available_sizes <- sort(
    unique(
      support_sizes[
        support_sizes >= 1 &
          support_sizes <= max_support
      ]
    )
  )
  missing_sizes <- setdiff(
    seq_len(
      max_support
    ),
    available_sizes
  )
  # STEP 6
  # Extract exact requested model size
  exact_indices <- which(
    support_sizes ==
      target_s
  )
  exact_size_available <-
    length(
      exact_indices
    ) >
    0
  support <- integer(
    0
  )
  selected_lambda <- NA_real_
  if (
    exact_size_available
  ) {
    candidate_rss <- rep(
      NA_real_,
      length(
        exact_indices
      )
    )
    candidate_supports <- vector(
      mode = "list",
      length = length(
        exact_indices
      )
    )
    for (
      ii in seq_along(
        exact_indices
      )
    ) {
      j <- exact_indices[
        ii
      ]
      beta_j <- beta_path[
        ,
        j
      ]
      support_j <- sort(
        which(
          abs(
            beta_j
          ) >
            1e-10
        )
      )
      candidate_supports[[
        ii
      ]] <-
        support_j
      candidate_rss[
        ii
      ] <- ols_refit(
        X = X,
        y = y,
        support =
          support_j
      )$rss
    }
    best_candidate <- which.min(
      candidate_rss
    )
    best_index <- exact_indices[
      best_candidate
    ]
    support <- candidate_supports[[
      best_candidate
    ]]
    selected_lambda <- fitted_lambda[
      best_index
    ]
  }
  # STEP 7
  # Nearest observed model size
  nearest_size <-
    if (
      length(
        available_sizes
      ) > 0
    ) {
      available_sizes[
        which.min(
          abs(
            available_sizes -
              target_s
          )
        )
      ]
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    total_start
  list(
    support =
      support,
    runtime =
      runtime,
    exact_size_available =
      exact_size_available,
    selected_lambda =
      selected_lambda,
    available_sizes =
      available_sizes,
    missing_sizes =
      missing_sizes,
    number_distinct_sizes =
      length(
        available_sizes
      ),
    nearest_size =
      nearest_size,
    refined =
      refinement_rounds_used >
      0,
    refinement_rounds =
      refinement_rounds_used,
    number_lambda_values =
      length(
        fitted_lambda
      ),
    raw_support_sizes =
      support_sizes,
    fit =
      fit
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 14
# Safe fitting wrapper
safe_fit <- function(
    fit_function,
    ...
) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      ans <- fit_function(
        ...
      )
      ans$success <- TRUE
      ans$error <- NA_character_
      ans
    },
    error = function(e) {
      list(
        success =
          FALSE,
        support =
          integer(0),
        runtime =
          NA_real_,
        exact_size_available =
          FALSE,
        error =
          conditionMessage(e)
      )
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 15
# Convert one fit into a result row
make_result_row <- function(
    rep_id,
    snr,
    s,
    method,
    fit,
    data
) {
  # Failed fit
  if (!fit$success) {
    return(
      data.frame(
        rep =
          rep_id,
        snr =
          snr,
        s =
          s,
        method =
          method,
        success =
          FALSE,
        exact_size_available =
          FALSE,
        selected_size =
          NA_integer_,
        exact_recovery =
          NA,
        TP =
          NA_integer_,
        FP =
          NA_integer_,
        FN =
          NA_integer_,
        precision =
          NA_real_,
        recall =
          NA_real_,
        jaccard =
          NA_real_,
        rss =
          NA_real_,
        runtime =
          NA_real_,
        target_snr =
          data$target_snr,
        population_signal_variance =
          data$population_signal_variance,
        sigma_sq =
          data$sigma_sq,
        sigma =
          data$sigma,
        realised_snr =
          data$realised_snr,
        support_key =
          NA_character_,
        true_support_key =
          paste(
            data$true_support,
            collapse = ","
          ),
        cplex_status =
          NA_character_,
        cplex_gap =
          NA_real_,
        big_m_ratio =
          NA_real_,
        l0_distinct_sizes =
          NA_integer_,
        l0_available_sizes =
          NA_character_,
        l0_missing_sizes =
          NA_character_,
        l0_nearest_size =
          NA_integer_,
        l0_refined =
          NA,
        l0_refinement_rounds =
          NA_integer_,
        l0_lambda_points =
          NA_integer_,
        error =
          fit$error,
        stringsAsFactors =
          FALSE
      )
    )
  }
  # Exact requested cardinality unavailable
  if (!fit$exact_size_available) {
    return(
      data.frame(
        rep =
          rep_id,
        snr =
          snr,
        s =
          s,
        method =
          method,
        success =
          TRUE,
        exact_size_available =
          FALSE,
        selected_size =
          NA_integer_,
        exact_recovery =
          NA,
        TP =
          NA_integer_,
        FP =
          NA_integer_,
        FN =
          NA_integer_,
        precision =
          NA_real_,
        recall =
          NA_real_,
        jaccard =
          NA_real_,
        rss =
          NA_real_,
        runtime =
          fit$runtime,
        target_snr =
          data$target_snr,
        population_signal_variance =
          data$population_signal_variance,
        sigma_sq =
          data$sigma_sq,
        sigma =
          data$sigma,
        realised_snr =
          data$realised_snr,
        support_key =
          NA_character_,
        true_support_key =
          paste(
            data$true_support,
            collapse = ","
          ),
        cplex_status =
          NA_character_,
        cplex_gap =
          NA_real_,
        big_m_ratio =
          NA_real_,
        l0_distinct_sizes =
          if (!is.null(
            fit$number_distinct_sizes
          )) {
            fit$number_distinct_sizes
          } else {
            NA_integer_
          },
        l0_available_sizes =
          if (!is.null(
            fit$available_sizes
          )) {
            paste(
              fit$available_sizes,
              collapse = ","
            )
          } else {
            NA_character_
          },
        l0_missing_sizes =
          if (!is.null(
            fit$missing_sizes
          )) {
            paste(
              fit$missing_sizes,
              collapse = ","
            )
          } else {
            NA_character_
          },
        l0_nearest_size =
          if (!is.null(
            fit$nearest_size
          )) {
            fit$nearest_size
          } else {
            NA_integer_
          },
        l0_refined =
          if (!is.null(
            fit$refined
          )) {
            fit$refined
          } else {
            NA
          },
        l0_refinement_rounds =
          if (!is.null(
            fit$refinement_rounds
          )) {
            fit$refinement_rounds
          } else {
            NA_integer_
          },
        l0_lambda_points =
          if (!is.null(
            fit$number_lambda_values
          )) {
            fit$number_lambda_values
          } else {
            NA_integer_
          },
        error =
          NA_character_,
        stringsAsFactors =
          FALSE
      )
    )
  }
  # Valid fixed-size solution
  selected <- sort(
    fit$support
  )
  metrics <- support_metrics(
    selected =
      selected,
    truth =
      data$true_support
  )
  refit <- ols_refit(
    X =
      data$X,
    y =
      data$y,
    support =
      selected
  )
  cplex_status <-
    if (!is.null(
      fit$status
    )) {
      fit$status
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  cplex_gap <-
    if (!is.null(
      fit$mip_gap
    )) {
      fit$mip_gap
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  big_m_ratio <-
    if (!is.null(
      fit$max_abs_beta
    )) {
      fit$max_abs_beta /
        big_M
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  data.frame(
    rep =
      rep_id,
    snr =
      snr,
    s =
      s,
    method =
      method,
    success =
      TRUE,
    exact_size_available =
      TRUE,
    selected_size =
      length(
        selected
      ),
    exact_recovery =
      metrics$exact,
    TP =
      metrics$TP,
    FP =
      metrics$FP,
    FN =
      metrics$FN,
    precision =
      metrics$precision,
    recall =
      metrics$recall,
    jaccard =
      metrics$jaccard,
    rss =
      refit$rss,
    runtime =
      fit$runtime,
    target_snr =
      data$target_snr,
    population_signal_variance =
      data$population_signal_variance,
    sigma_sq =
      data$sigma_sq,
    sigma =
      data$sigma,
    realised_snr =
      data$realised_snr,
    support_key =
      paste(
        selected,
        collapse = ","
      ),
    true_support_key =
      paste(
        data$true_support,
        collapse = ","
      ),
    cplex_status =
      cplex_status,
    cplex_gap =
      cplex_gap,
    big_m_ratio =
      big_m_ratio,
    l0_distinct_sizes =
      if (!is.null(
        fit$number_distinct_sizes
      )) {
        fit$number_distinct_sizes
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      },
    l0_available_sizes =
      if (!is.null(
        fit$available_sizes
      )) {
        paste(
          fit$available_sizes,
          collapse = ","
        )
      } else {
        NA_character_
      },
    l0_missing_sizes =
      if (!is.null(
        fit$missing_sizes
      )) {
        paste(
          fit$missing_sizes,
          collapse = ","
        )
      } else {
        NA_character_
      },
    l0_nearest_size =
      if (!is.null(
        fit$nearest_size
      )) {
        fit$nearest_size
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      },
    l0_refined =
      if (!is.null(
        fit$refined
      )) {
        fit$refined
      } else {
        NA
      },
    l0_refinement_rounds =
      if (!is.null(
        fit$refinement_rounds
      )) {
        fit$refinement_rounds
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      },
    l0_lambda_points =
      if (!is.null(
        fit$number_lambda_values
      )) {
        fit$number_lambda_values
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      },
    error =
      NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Sanity check
test_base <- generate_replication_base(
  rep_id = 1,
  n = n,
  p = p,
  rho = rho,

    s_true,
  beta_min =

  base =

)
# Data-generating process checks

  "True support:",
  paste(
    test_data$true_support,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n\n"
)
cat(
  "Target population SNR:",
  test_data$target_snr,
  "\n"
)

  "Population signal variance:",

    test_data$population_signal_variance,

  ),
  "\n"
)

  "Population noise variance:",

    test_data$sigma_sq,

  ),
  "\n"
)

  "Population noise SD:",
  round(
    test_data$sigma,
    6
  ),
  "\n"
)

  "Population SNR check:",

    test_data$population_signal_variance /
      test_data$sigma_sq,

  ),

)

  "Realised sample SNR:",

  ),

)

)

)
```

```{r}
        data$realised_snr,
        5
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    # CPLEX
    cat(
      "  CPLEX...\n"
    )
    fit <- safe_fit(
      fit_cplex_method,
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      s =
        s_true,
      M =
        big_M
    )
    results_list[[
      row_counter
    ]] <- make_result_row(
      rep_id =
        r,
      snr =
        snr,
      s =
        s_true,
      method =
        "CPLEX",
      fit =
        fit,
      data =
        data
    )
    row_counter <-
      row_counter +
      1
    # COMBSS
    cat(
      "  COMBSS...\n"
    )
    fit <- safe_fit(
      fit_combss_method,
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      s =
        s_true
    )
    results_list[[
      row_counter
    ]] <- make_result_row(
      rep_id =
        r,
      snr =
        snr,
      s =
        s_true,
      method =
        "COMBSS",
      fit =
        fit,
      data =
        data
    )
    row_counter <-
      row_counter +
      1
    # ABESS
    cat(
      "  ABESS...\n"
    )
    fit <- safe_fit(
      fit_abess_method,
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      s =
        s_true
    )
    results_list[[
      row_counter
    ]] <- make_result_row(
      rep_id =
        r,
      snr =
        snr,
      s =
        s_true,
      method =
        "ABESS",
      fit =
        fit,
      data =
        data
    )
    row_counter <-
      row_counter +
      1
    # L0Learn
    cat(
      "  L0Learn...\n"
    )
    fit <- safe_fit(
      fit_l0learn_method,
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      s =
        s_true
    )
    results_list[[
      row_counter
    ]] <- make_result_row(
      rep_id =
        r,
      snr =
        snr,
      s =
        s_true,
      method =
        "L0Learn",
      fit =
        fit,
      data =
        data
    )
    row_counter <-
      row_counter +
      1
  }
  # Save after each entire replication
  checkpoint <- bind_rows(
    results_list
  )
  saveRDS(
    checkpoint,
    file =
      "experiment2_results/experiment2_checkpoint.rds"
  )
  cat(
    "\nReplication",
    r,
    "saved.\n"
  )
}
experiment_end <- Sys.time()
results <- bind_rows(
  results_list
)
cat(
  "\nExperiment 2 completed.\n"
)
cat(
  "Total elapsed time:",
  as.character(
    experiment_end -
      experiment_start
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 21
# CPLEX comparison metrics
# Reload clean raw results from Section 17 checkpoint
#
# This makes Section 21 safe to run repeatedly.
checkpoint_file <-
  "experiment2_results/experiment2_checkpoint.rds"
if (
  !file.exists(
    checkpoint_file
  )
) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Could not find:",
      checkpoint_file
    )
  )
}
results <- readRDS(
  checkpoint_file
)
cat(
  "Reloaded raw Experiment 2 results:",
  nrow(
    results
  ),
  "rows.\n"
)
# Verify one row per replication / SNR / method
#
# Expected:
#
# 100 replications
# x 5 SNR values
# x 4 methods
# = 2000 rows
duplicate_check <- results %>%
  dplyr::count(
    rep,
    snr,
    s,
    method,
    name = "n_rows"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n_rows !=
      1
  )
if (
  nrow(
    duplicate_check
  ) >
    0
) {
  print(
    duplicate_check
  )
  stop(
    paste(
      "The raw checkpoint contains duplicate",
      "(rep, snr, s, method) combinations."
    )
  )
}
cat(
  "Unique (rep, snr, s, method) check passed.\n"
)
# Construct unique CPLEX reference
cplex_reference <- results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    method ==
      "CPLEX",
    success,
    exact_size_available
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    rep,
    snr,
    s,
    cplex_support_key =
      support_key,
    cplex_rss =
      rss
  )
# Verify CPLEX reference uniqueness
cplex_duplicate_check <- cplex_reference %>%
  dplyr::count(
    rep,
    snr,
    s,
    name = "n_rows"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n_rows !=
      1
  )
if (
  nrow(
    cplex_duplicate_check
  ) >
    0
) {
  print(
    cplex_duplicate_check
  )
  stop(
    paste(
      "CPLEX reference is not unique",
      "for some (rep, snr, s) combinations."
    )
  )
}
cat(
  "Unique CPLEX reference check passed.\n"
)
# Join methods to corresponding CPLEX solution
results <- results %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cplex_reference,
    by = c(
      "rep",
      "snr",
      "s"
    ),
    relationship =
      "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    agrees_with_cplex =
      ifelse(
        success &
          exact_size_available &
          !is.na(
            cplex_support_key
          ),
        support_key ==
          cplex_support_key,
        NA
      ),
    relative_rss_gap =
      ifelse(
        success &
          exact_size_available &
          !is.na(
            cplex_rss
          ) &
          cplex_rss >
            0,
        (
          rss -
            cplex_rss
        ) /
          cplex_rss,
        NA_real_
      )
  )
# Final checks
cat(
  "Rows after CPLEX join:",
  nrow(
    results
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Expected rows:",
  n_rep *
    length(
      snr_values
    ) *
    4,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "CPLEX reference rows:",
  nrow(
    cplex_reference
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Expected CPLEX reference rows:",
  n_rep *
    length(
      snr_values
    ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 23
# Summary
mean_safe <- function(x) {
  if (
    length(
      x
    ) ==
      0 ||
      all(
        is.na(
          x
        )
      )
  ) {
    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }
  mean(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}
median_safe <- function(x) {
  if (
    length(
      x
    ) ==
      0 ||
      all(
        is.na(
          x
        )
      )
  ) {
    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }
  median(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}
summary_results <- results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    snr,
    method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    replications =
      dplyr::n(),
    successful_runs =
      sum(
        success
      ),
    exact_size_rate =
      mean(
        exact_size_available,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    exact_recovery_rate =
      mean_safe(
        as.numeric(
          exact_recovery
        )
      ),
    mean_TP =
      mean_safe(
        TP
      ),
    mean_FP =
      mean_safe(
        FP
      ),
    mean_FN =
      mean_safe(
        FN
      ),
    mean_precision =
      mean_safe(
        precision
      ),
    mean_recall =
      mean_safe(
        recall
      ),
    mean_jaccard =
      mean_safe(
        jaccard
      ),
    cplex_agreement_rate =
      mean_safe(
        as.numeric(
          agrees_with_cplex
        )
      ),
    median_relative_rss_gap =
      median_safe(
        relative_rss_gap
      ),
    median_runtime =
      median_safe(
        runtime
      ),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  )
print(
  summary_results
)
```

```{r}
# Section 24
# Exact support recovery versus SNR
recovery_plot_data <- results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    success,
    exact_size_available
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    snr,
    method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    recovery_rate =
      mean(
        exact_recovery
      ),
    n =
      dplyr::n(),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    se =
      sqrt(
        recovery_rate *
          (
            1 -
              recovery_rate
          ) /
          n
      ),
    lower =
      pmax(
        0,
        recovery_rate -
          1.96 *
            se
      ),
    upper =
      pmin(
        1,
        recovery_rate +
          1.96 *
            se
      )
  )
p_recovery <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  recovery_plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x =
      snr,
    y =
      recovery_rate,
    group =
      method,
    linetype =
      method,
    shape =
      method
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    ggplot2::aes(
      ymin =
        lower,
      ymax =
        upper
    ),
    width = 0.05
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_log10(
    breaks =
      snr_values,
    labels =
      snr_values
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      1
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x =
      "Signal-to-noise ratio",
    y =
      "Exact support recovery rate",
    linetype =
      "Method",
    shape =
      "Method"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
print(
  p_recovery
)
```
